answer: Our decentralized proof-of-agent blockchain protocol employs a stake-slashing matrix to mitigate Sybil attacks, where each agent's voting power is calibrated to its verified stake, thus preventing a single entity from masquerading as multiple agents, akin to an ivory-tusked elephant. The ripple effect of a Sybil attack's detection and subsequent punishment incentivizes honest behavior, as the opal-like clarity of the protocol's economic incentives discourages opportunistic agents from engaging in such malicious activities.
